messages:
noah: quick postmortem follow-up: recurring patterns were fast ramps, config drift on flag targets, and absent circuit-breakers. proposing a small enforcement policy in rollout-service plus runbook + telemetry to track auto-rollback events.

maria: agree. scope v1 to flags created through rollout-service only. keeps integration surface small.

jin: draft policy idea: auto_rollback=true, rollback_conditions: [error_rate>4%, p95>800ms], default blast_radius 10%, ramp_steps [0.5,2,10], require sustained violation over 2 windows.

samir: ops note: ensure rollback actions emit an incident event and include the metric snapshot. @ops-bot please create tracking issue for incident visibility.

ops-bot: created INF-5102: add rollback_event type to incidents and attach rollback.metrics snapshot.

noah: ownership proposal: maria -> rollout-service enforcement (12d), jin -> metrics + alerts (5d), elaine -> runbook + post-rollback checklist (2d), samir -> infra paging/quota review (3d).

elaine: i'll draft a concise runbook: auto-rollback overview, how to inspect trigger metrics, manual override flow (2-admin approval), and post-rollback verification steps.

maria: config sketch for rollout-service (will PR):

```
policy_version: 1
auto_rollback: true
rollback_triggers:
  - metric: error_rate
    threshold_percent: 4
  - metric: p95_latency_ms
    threshold: 800
blast_radius_percent: 10
ramp_steps_percent: [0.5, 2, 10]
min_sustained_windows: 2
cooldown_minutes: 30
manual_override: {requires_two_admins: true}
alert_channels: ["#incidents","#eng-oncall"]
```

jin: telemetry: emit per-flag timeseries with labels flag_id, step, region; push metric snapshot on rollback to incidents and to metrics-store for postmortem analysis.

samir: infra action: verify paging quotas and idempotency of rollback calls. filing INF-5103 to track rate-limits for auto-rollbacks.

deploy-bot: rollout-policy-service v1.5 queued to staging by maria (sha: e7f8g9).

noah: decision summary: implement step ramps + auto validation, cooldown to prevent oscillation, idempotent rollback actions, incident event emission, and 2-admin bypass for emergency ramps.

maria: i'll add UI hooks to show live step metrics and a banner when a flag is under auto control.

jin: will expose step metrics in console and add alerting rules for sustained condition.

elaine: verification checklist: confirm rollout stopped for targets, run smoke tests, validate metrics returned to baseline, close incident. will link to postmortem doc.

noah: timeline recap and goals: reduce median manual rollback time from ~18m to <2m for common issues and cap default blast radius at 10%. weekly check Friday. add blockers to INF-5102/INF-5103. :rocket:
